ADX 29.3으로 뚜렷한 추세 유지하나 -DI 33.9가 +DI 13.8 대비 우위로 하락 압력 우세. 4시간봉 RSI 31.3으로 과매도 구간 진입. 종합적으로 하락 추세 속 과매도 구간 진입 및 Higher Low 패턴 초입 확인으로 매수 진입은 이르나, 약세 흐름 지속 및 중장기 이평선 하회로 매도 진입도 부담. 관망 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 32.8 entering oversold territory, MACD histogram at -2.0371 continuing to worsen. 5-day low of $153.91 is above the 20-day low of $152.60, confirming the initial stage of a Higher Low pattern. Current price of $156.56 is 1.77% above SMA200 at $153.84 but -12.16% below EMA50 at $178.24, maintaining a medium-to-long-term bearish trend. Weekly RSI is 46.9 and weekly MACD histogram is -2.5788, indicating a bearish phase. ADX is 29.3, showing a clear trend, but -DI at 33.9 is dominant over +DI at 13.8, suggesting downward pressure. 4-hour RSI is 31.3, entering oversold territory. Overall, entering oversold territory within a downtrend and confirming the initial stage of a Higher Low pattern makes a buy entry premature. However, the persistent bearish trend and trading below medium-to-long-term moving averages also make a sell entry challenging. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
